scope: Local synthetic smoke test, 2026-11-07. Single-language and same-window Japanese/English code-switching. Release gate requires both.
environment: macOS arm64; macOS say at default rate; ffmpeg mono PCM16 16000 Hz. Mixed input is Japanese WAV + 16000 zero samples + English WAV.
